snippet.title: Death Howl | 11 Facts Trailer
snippet.description:
🧡Play Demo and wishlist #DeathHowl now: https://re.11bits.com/cri

Discover 11 essential truths about the grim world of Death Howl🦌

From turn-based, grid-bound combat and strategic deck-building to the raw, emotional weight of a mother’s grief, Death Howl offers a genre-blending experience rooted in sorrow, survival, and spirit. 

Craft your deck. Face the unknown. Master your path. Death Howl arrives tomorrow! 🌲🃏
